en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural residential area with detached houses bordering an open field of tall grass. The sky is filled with large cumulus clouds. In the foreground is a two‑storey house with a gabled roof and a columned porch; several similar houses and farm buildings are scattered in the background. Printed text appears in the lower left and lower right corners, identifying the place and the publisher.
